batting.name: D Padikkal
batting.dismissal: c KD Karthik b LH Ferguson

batting.name: KS Bharat
batting.dismissal: c Shubman Gill b AD Russell

batting.name: Sachin Baby
batting.dismissal: c N Rana b CV Varun

batting.name: Mohammed Siraj
batting.dismissal: c CV Varun b AD Russell

batting.name: Shubman Gill
batting.dismissal: c Mohammed Siraj b YS Chahal

balls.text: this time he gets bat to ball in trying to scoop that but guess what? He's picked out fine leg. Ah, he didn't even have to move an inch.
off the pad, and down leg. He walked across a long way to flick that but the ball was angling in and was going down as well.
jams his bat down in time to squeeze this wide yorker to deep point
walked across to try and scoop this slower ball but is beaten
so close to knocking the off pole! Backed away to squeeze behind point, missed it completely
nudges this short ball into the leg side for a quick single
makes room to slash over point but gets a thick edge that flies between keeper and slip
length outside off, he uses the pace to steer this behind point
squirts this off a thick inside edge to square leg
beaten as he tries to squeeze this yorker behind point
pushed into the off side with soft hands
pushes this full and fast delivery into the covers
defends this full and fast delivery into the off side
right on top of the bounce as he defends back
short of length on off, hits him high on the body as he tries to get behind the line
right into the blockhole, 'you miss, I hit' stuff. Harshal exposed all three stumps in trying to scythe that behind point. It was the slower yorker. Lovely delivery.
beaten by this slower one! Was through with this attempted slap even before the ball arrived
thick edge, flies past the diving DK for four! Beaten for pace as he tried to slash that short ball.
short leg was in business as Siraj gets a thick inside edge onto the pad as the ball rolls down towards fine leg
heaved into the leg side, down to deep midwicket
breaks back in to hit Harshal on the pad as he plays for the legbreak

looks like Jamieson is gone! Varun may have got a feather of a finger in trying to stop that hard drive down the ground. Yes, replays confirm that. Jamieson was off the field even before 'OUT' flashed on the screen.
lofted but no timing or power, down to long-off on the bounce
mistimes this attempted lofted hit to short midwicket
through with the sweep even before the ball arrived, ball deflects off the thigh pad towards Russell at slip
cramps him for room with a length ball on middle, defended back
rocks back and slaps this short ball to sweeper cover
gets a thick bottom edge as he shapes for a cut, and this one skids past short third for a welcome boundary
pushed down to long-off
quicker length ball on off, defends
swung back over the bowler's head, didn't get hold of it but just managed to elude Varun as he leapt high
struck on the pad as the ball drifts in to hit him high
deceived and gone! He slices this straight to backward point. Baby doesn't pick the wrong'un as he looks to swing into the leg side, the easy catch popped to Nitish Rana.
turns this back towards the bowler
cuts this straight to backward point
smacks the drive straight to cover
floater on off stump, defended back. RCB walking a tightrope
cramped for room as he pushes this back to the bowler
mistimes a lofted hit into the deep cover region
tries to work it to the leg side, rolls off the outer part to gully
nearly chopped on! Looks to punch on the up but the slowness of the surface had him a tad confused. Off the inside edge onto the leg side.
tucks this gently behind square on the legside for a quick single

Varun pleads Morgan for a review as he strikes the pad, but the captain is unmoved. What drama! Jamieson has a long reach and was well forward and outside the line as he tried to play that. But it  looks like an inside edge saved him.

big shout for lbw, given! Wanindu completely misreads that and plays for the turn away, but this one pitches on middle and skids through to crash into the pad. As an umpire, Nigel Llong couldn't have asked for an easier decision to make.

bowled him with a superb delivery!  Flicks his fingers over the ball, tosses it up, gets it to drift in and skid through on middle, Maxwell went for an ugly mow but was through with it early, the ball sneaked through to crash into the stumps.
leading edge, but safe. Lobs towards where mid-off would be, easy single again
flatter one on middle and leg, tucked wide of midwicket
fullish on leg, worked to deep midwicket
yorker length outside off, and he gets a bottom edge on to his boot after clearing his front leg
high full-toss on off, and he swivels his pull to deep square leg. Above-waist no-ball is called
good length ball just outside off, and driven down to deep point
on the bounce to mid-on, as he chips this full ball on middle! Mix-up between both batters, as Maxwell is down on the ground at the keeper's end. Safe in the end though
shorter and wider of off. He gets his push from the outside half of the bat toward third man
appeal for leg before, but looked like there was an inside edge. Yorker length ball on middle, tailing into the batter. He gets an inside edge to his flick, as the ball rolls over to the off side
goes for the drive, but is beaten. Full ball and slightly wide of off, as the batter plays away from his body with the ball beating his outside edge
fuller ball on middle, and clips this to fine leg. He wants a second, but is denied. Off the mark, finally
short of a length ball on middle, and defended back to the bowler
fuller ball on leg, and it strikes his front pad as he misses his flick. The ball trickles toward square leg after striking him
good length ball on middle and leg, and he clips it with the closed face of the bat toward midwicket
really full and outside off, driven along the ground to the right of deep point
short of a length outside off, and pushed back to the bowler's right after riding the bounce
this was on a good length and slightly wide of off, but fuller than the previous ball. Baby again sways away and ducks to leave it alone
slightly short of a length on middle and off, and with good bounce. Left alone after swaying away

bowled him first ball! A crashing yorker has de Villiers for a golden duck! Very full ball on middle and leg, which is also shaping to come into the batter. de Villiers' front leg is on leg stump, as the ball strikes that to ricochet behind to the stumps. What a blow for the Royal Challengers
much fuller on middle, and he opens the bat face to push that toward cover
shortish in length on off, and it is punched to the man at short cover

pulled to deep square leg, and a good catch by Gill running to his right! Goes for the pull to this short ball on off, with the ball almost rushing on to him. He was nearly off balance too while playing that, and seemed to have got that from the higher side of the bat too. Not a great innings by Bharat, considering he was in early and during the powerplay
goes reverse-sweep to this good length ball outside off, but is beaten all over! Shuffles across as well, and the ball ends up hitting his body
fullish just outside off, and he can only toe-end that back toward the bowler's right
driven down to long-on off this full length ball on off
very full on middle, and pushed down to long-on. Maxwell wanted two, but is sent back
top-edge, but safe. Goes to cut this short ball wide of off playing away from his body, with the ball turning away as short third man dives low to his right
turns into him from a short of a  length on middle, as Maxwell misses his pull

walks across off, and chips this full ball outside off to deep midwicket. It was in the air for a while but safe, with all the space available there, especially since it wasn't hit all that forcefully
clips this good length delivery on middle to deep square leg
good length ball on leg, and good bounce again. The ball balloons to point off his front thigh pad
Rana at point dives to his right, and saves three runs. Short of a length ball and slightly wide of off, as he cuts that from dee in his crease
short of a length on middle, and climbs on to the batter. Maxwell has his bottom hand off, as he turns that behind to fine leg to get off the mark
good length ball on middle, and clipped behind to fine leg

taken behind by Karthik, and Knight Riders wrap up the powerplay with a wicket! Padikkal looks to ramp that good length ball on middle toward third man, but the ball is too close to his body to play that shot, since he has to sway out of the way and go low too. There is a thick outside edge there, and Ferguson has his man
slower ball, and a yorker length ball just outside off. Padikkal looks to jam that out, but that is too full, with the ball passing between his bat and pad
clips this fullish ball outside off toward square leg by going across off stump
gives himself room to hammer that over cover, but is beaten! Good length ball on middle and off, with the ball just passing over the stumps as the batter missed his shot
dabs this fullish ball outside off to third man. The run was taken rapidly, perhaps in anticipation of two
sliced to deep point! Not all that short, but on a good length outside off, and he uses the pace of the bowler to cut from close to his body. Beats point to his right, as it races away for four

clears his front leg, and goes inside out over covers! Full ball on middle, and the room he gave himself meant he had the space to loft that with the open face of the bat to bring up a boundary after some singles in the over
skids on with a hint of turn into him, as Narine goes full on middle. Flicked behind to fine leg
much fuller on middle, and driven to the man at cover
turns into the batter after pitching on a good length on middle, as Bharat clips it to deep square leg
slower, and fuller on off. Pushed toward cover for a quick single, with Tripathi hitting the stumps at the keeper's end with a dive
Hides the ball to go full outside off, which is tapped to short third man
pulls his length back to go on a good length on middle and off, as Padikkal clips this toward square leg for a single
much fuller, and just outside off. Hint of movement away from the batter, who taps this with the open face of the bat toward point
walks across off, and clips this full-toss on his pads over short fine leg for four. His right hand came off as he played that, and wasn't quite in control, but he won't mind
high full-toss on off, and he flicks it only to be taken at fine leg! But it is a free-hit, so he survives. And another no-ball is called, this time for height
makes room, but still finds cover-point with the slash to this fullish ball outside off. Another dot for Bharat. But guess what? It is a no-ball
beaten outside off! Goes for the drive away from his body to this good length ball wide of off, but the ball passes his outside edge, as he was shuffling across off too
full length again, and just outside off. Pushed through toward mid-off
pretty full ball just outside off, and he finds the cover fielder with his drive
very full and just outside off, driven to mid-off for a rapid run. Direct hit from the fielder, and the umpire goes upstairs for a potential run-out. Replays show he was easily home
goes for the pull to this good length ball outside off, but the ball hits his body instead as he tried to swivel
pulls his length back to go on a good length on middle, as it is clipped toward mid-on's left
gloriously lifted over the bowler's head! Effortless from Padikkal. Full ball on middle, and he simply lofts that with the full face of the bat for a one-bounce four
good length ball again, but this was angling in from off stump. Clipped to deep square leg for a single
runs this good length ball outside off to third man by opening the face of the bat
on a good length on off, and clipped to square leg, with the wide space available to the right of mid-on. A quick two is completed for his first runs
drives this full delivery outside off to mid-off, while shuffling across off as well

rapped in front, and given! Prasidh hits back right away. But Kohli reviews. The ball was fullish on middle, and was darting back in as Kohli went to flick that toward square leg and missed. No inside edge is confirmed by UltraEdge. Looks like it would be clipping leg stump, with a possible chance of umpire's call there. There is a bit of wait for ball tracking though... But it is three reds, and replays confirm that would have hit the top of leg. What a vital breakthrough so early for Knight Riders
crunches this cover drive for four! Good length ball just outside off, and he presents the full face of the bat to find the gap between cover and mid-off. Excellent drive
good length ball on middle and leg, and angling down further. Wide delivery to the right-hander
good length ball on off, and he sways away a touch while dabbing that late to third man while playing close to his body
full ball on off, and right on length. Padikkal goes low to block that with the open face of the bat
defends this full delivery on off toward cover, with his bottom hand coming off
finds the gap between point and cover! Good diving stop by Russell all the way to boundary. This was a shortish ball just outside off, and he rocked back to punch that from close to his body
opens the bat face to tap this full ball outside off to point, and still can't get off the mark
leading edge toward cover. Goes for the flick to this fullish ball on off, but the bat turns in his hands after the extra bounce too
pretty full on off, and driven to extra cover. He wanted a single, but was sent back
good length ball outside off, he closes the bat face to clip it to square leg and get off the mark
he has absolutely clobbered the pull to the deep midwicket boundary and  KKR have shellacked RCB by nine wickets!
steps out and powers this down the ground, bisects long-on and long-off. Boy, isn't he strong or what?
slows it down nicely as he lands it on a length, Iyer pushes it back down the pitch
he has picked the googly and reverse-swept him disdainfully over point
drilled, but that's an excellent diving stop by Kohli moving to his left from extra cover
he's holed out to long-off. Gill lives by the sword, dies by it. Looking to step out and launch Yuzi down into Sheikh Zayed Road, but doesn't time it well. Ends up slicing this to Siraj.
wrists this length ball to the man coming in from deep midwicket

whips this full toss on middle and leg, and guess what happens? The deep midwicket fielder makes a right royal mess of a simple stop. Oh, Sachin Baby! He overran the ball, then slipped in trying to correct himself.
slower bouncer outside off, Gill lets that pass at the last moment
tough chance put down by Harshal  on his followthrough! This was punched back by Iyer and Harshal put in a dive to his left, went one-handed, but didn't stick.
beaten as he tries to run this down to third man. First gave the impression that he'd walk across, then made room to manufacture a stroke, nothing worked.
steps out to a full toss as he punches it past cover
he has switch-pulled him over backward point! Wanindu dragged it down, he had enough time to change grip and help it over.
drops short, he rocks back and cuts to deep cover
flatter and fuller on middle, turns it into the leg side
has a wild swing at this, gets a thick inside edge down to fine leg for a couple
covers for the line as he picks this wrong'un and clobbers this over long-on! Excellent use of the feet
struck on the pad as he doesn't pick the googly, but Gill was a long way forward and this would've missed leg too.
steps out, Harshal bangs it in and Iyer can't connect in trying to pull. Was off balance, the ball rolls off the toe-end to midwicket
makes room, Harshal follows him by cramping him for room, punched to deep point
delicate dab down to third man as he jogs the single
punches this length delivery to sweeper cover
slips this slower ball way down leg, KS Bharat with a dive to stop that from being five wides
steps out and punches this wide of mid-off
wrists this full delivery outside off towards long-on
full delivery on off again, and driven to mid-off to round off the powerplay
reverse-sweep now. Goes low to this full ball on off, and that is played with the turn away from him for a couple
slogged to deep midwicket! Gill in some mood today. Again sweeps this full ball outside off by going down on his back knee and cracks that for four
the wrong one now. Shortish in length outside off, and cut to cover with the turn
goes down, and slog-sweeps this full ball on off to long leg! Went down on his back knee, and got into a great position to hammer that away
full ball on off, and pushed back to the bowler

crashed over mid-on! Skips down the track to this full ball on middle, and he lofts that with the closed face of the bat to clear the boundary by some distance. Didn't seem like that was hit very powerfully, and had great timing and placement there
almost a yorker length on middle and leg, with Gill coming down the pitch again. Pushes it toward mid-off
much fuller on leg, and he backs away to loft over covers! Scrambled seam ball, and Gill opens the bat face to lift that for four to deep extra cover
short delivery on off, and he gets good bounce with that, a Gill misses his attempted ramp over the keeper. Good use of the height there by Jamieson
very full and very wide of off. Not called a wide, since Gill was across off already. But guess what? It is a front-foot no-ball anyway
much fuller on off, and this is driven to mid-off with a good stride forward
skips down, and thrashes that back! Slapped between the bowler and the man at mid-off. Shortish in length on off, and Gill also gives himself room to hammer that away
very full on middle and off, and jammed to cover, where the man dives to his left to get a hand
cracked to the right of mid-off! Leans forward into the drive to this full ball outside off, and plays that like a half-volley
goes for the switch-hit, but is beaten completely. Full ball on off, and turning away this time
googly now. Short of a length on middle, and pulled to deep square with the turn into him
full ball on middle, with a hint of turn away. Pushed toward long-on
very full on off, and driven to long-off
good dive by Hasaranga at cover-point to his left. Iyer punches at this good length ball on off, and sets off for a single
short delivery on middle, and good bounce there. Iyer watches it go to the keeper, as if confident of it being a wide. But it is just called first bouncer
dances down to this good length ball on middle, but can only push that toward mid-off
goes for the flash to this good length ball on middle, but is beaten. That was too close to cut too
Jamieson runs to his left and dives to stop the ball. Short and wide of off, and Iyer cuts that away from his body
low full-toss on off, and he drives that with the full face of the bat, but finds cover-point
full ball on off, and Gill pushes at that tentatively, with his bottom hand off as well
this is full on middle, and angling down leg. Another wide in the over, as the keeper collects that to his left
very full and wide of off. Seemed like it slipped out of his hands too. Hint of movement after pitching, but a wide still
good length ball on his pads, clipped to fine leg. Iyer wanted a second, but was sent back
good stop by short midwicket. Dives to his right, and gets a hand. Another short ball on off, as Gill pulls. Rather, it is more a short-arm jab - the typical Gill shot
shorter and wide of off, cut away to mid-off, where Maxwell stops the ball to his left

skips down, and rams that over mid-on! Bowled on a fullish length on off and with a scrambled seam, as Gill makes room by standing on leg stump. He closes the bat face while lifting that, as the ball enters the fence just on the bounce
cover and cover-point dive to their left and right respectively, but the ball beats them both. Gill punches this good length ball outside off, and bags two
good length ball outside off, and nudged to cover, as the bat turns in his hands
creamed through the covers! This time bisects mid-off and extra cover with his drive, as he presents the full face of the bat to this full ball wide of off
finds the gap between point and cover, and four to get off the mark! Another short delivery which wide wide of off, and he cuts that fine and while also going low
again shortish, but this is really wide of off. This time has a swash at that away from his body, but no bat. Wide called
shorter in length, and close to off. Goes for the flash to cut that, but is beaten
pulls his length ball to go shorter outside off, as it is pushed to the left of mid-on, who stretches out his left hand and gets a finger tip, although that can't prevent a single
pretty full and just outside off. Driven to the right of the man at cover, who misses the ball with his dive, as it rolls over to mid-off
